purpose: Preview only; not integrated into the game
generation: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity portrait mobile game screen concept, 9:16 aspect, for the existing cute fantasy survival game Mochi Mayhem. The page is its Power hub, a decision screen for getting stronger. This is a readable practical game UI concept, not a promotional poster. Visual language: hand-painted charming crystal/candy fantasy, deep plum matte panels, soft parchment white typography, restrained pale gold outlines, mint gain accents, hints of strawberry rose. Avoid lavish gold frames, neon glow, overdecoration, busy illustrations behind text, tiny text. Keep generous quiet surfaces and visibly large tap targets. The whole screen fits without scrolling and feels clean and approachable. Structure from top to bottom: compact header with back chevron and title 'POWER', small candy currency chip. Then a summary panel with small faceted crystal crest on left, large '1,240' and label 'Your Power', right smaller 'Next stage C1-3', 'Recommended 1,500', a thin mint progress bar and '260 Power to go'. No full-height character illustration. Then a clearly separated heading 'BEST NEXT STEPS'. Three short horizontal recommendation rows: first gently highlighted in warm pale gold, small painted sword-and-shield icon, title 'Equip better gear', subtitle 'Upgrade 2 slots from your bag', green gain '+120', small right chevron. Second small heart-crystal icon, title 'Weave Life Core', subtitle '2 levels within your Sugar budget', gain '+80'. Third small smithing anvil icon, title 'Enhance equipped gear', subtitle 'Use your Weave Thread', gain '+45'. Keep gains visually distinct from buttons. Below that a quiet small 'Rank reward ready' claim chip. Then heading 'ALL POWER OPTIONS' and four equal compact illustrated tiles in a 2 by 2 grid, comfortable for fingers: 'Weave' shows a small three-crystal altar joined by delicate threads, 'Equipment' shows cute sword shield gloves; 'Merge' shows three matching small crystals combining into one brighter crystal, 'Forge' shows a small candy-forging anvil and pale mint potion. These tile paintings occupy only the left third of each horizontal tile, label and chevron on the right, so nothing is crowded. All four distinct identities, matched art style and scale. Finally a small understated bottom navigation Home / Power / Heroes with Power active. Use exactly the English copy provided and clear, consistent rounded sans-serif type, strong hierarchy, less framing than a typical ornate fantasy game. Main screen content takes priority, background only dim plum workshop architecture at side edges, no other branding or floating decorations. Render at crisp mobile app design presentation quality. Numbers are illustrative mockup values.
refinement: Edit this Power hub UI concept, preserving its full layout, typography, restrained plum/gold/mint style, all existing labels, icons, screen proportions and readability. Correct ONLY these three gameplay semantics: (1) the lower-left Merge tile illustration must show THREE matching small red-and-gold shields on the left combining via one right arrow into ONE larger more ornate violet-rarity shield on the right. This represents merging equipment of the same slot and rarity, not upgrading currency crystals. Keep it small and readable, with the 'Merge' text unobstructed. (2) the top-right currency icon next to 320 should be a cute pink wrapped candy representing Sugar, not a faceted gem. Keep 320 and plus unchanged. (3) the thin power progress bar next to Recommended 1,500 should visually be about 83 percent filled, consistent with 1,240 / 1,500. Preserve all other illustrations, spacing and text. This is a design mockup, not runtime artwork.
